snippet.title: Mr. "Bargain Expert" 捡漏王 // Trailer
snippet.description:
Steam ► https://store.steampowered.com/app/4660700/Mr_Bargain_Expert

Play as an antique shop owner in this incremental idle management game. Buy low and sell high, appraise and acquire valuable antiques, hire employees to automate the business, expand into new branches, build your own antique empire, and collect rare treasures.

👥 Players: Single-player
🛠️ Developer: Cheese Meow
📚 Publisher: Cheese Meow
📅 Release Date: Q4 2026
🎯 Genre: Simulation, Casual
